integrity.proof_basis: Analytic spectral decomposition and a contradiction argument on any proposed finite accumulation time.

scientific_limitations.not_proved: No uniform positive dwell time over all initial states; no extension to arbitrary semigroups, feedback operators, or trigger definitions.
scientific_limitations.proved: No finite accumulation of event times for each fixed initial state and each positive threshold.
scientific_limitations.scope: Neumann heat equation on L2(0,1), identity actuation, rank-one constant-mode feedback, full-state relative trigger.

title: Pointwise non-Zeno behavior without a uniform dwell-time bound for a sampled-data heat equation
